name: SkeletonButton

props.description: Height, from the --control-height tier Button sizes from.
props.name: size

props.description: Corner, in Button's own vocabulary. `pill` is Ant Design's shape="round".
props.name: shape

props.description: Fill the inline axis instead of holding the control's own measure.
props.name: block

props.description: Travelling sheen instead of the pulse.
props.name: active

tagline: Button-shaped placeholder (also Skeleton.Button) — two control-heights wide.
usage: DO use it in a toolbar or card footer whose actions depend on data that has not arrived.
DO pass `block` when the real Button spans its column, so the row does not reflow on swap.
DON'T render a disabled Button as a loading state — a disabled control announces a different thing.
